assessment.nobel_worthiness: Virus-like particle vaccination has produced a major, durable advance in prevention of HPV infection and associated cancers.
assessment.attribution: The three proposed laureates represent central experimental and translational contributions to the VLP vaccine platform.
assessment.maturity: The protective mechanism and population-scale clinical value are firmly established.
uncertainties: The underlying work involved broader contributions across virology, immunology, and vaccine development.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 biology enabled exceptionally consequential treatments for diabetes and obesity while clarifying fundamental endocrine control of metabolism.
assessment.attribution: Holst, Mojsov, and Drucker make a coherent group spanning identification of GLP-1 physiology and its biological development.
assessment.maturity: The physiology, pharmacology, and extensive therapeutic impact are mature and independently confirmed.
uncertainties: The boundary between foundational physiology and later medicinal-chemistry and clinical-development credit is difficult to draw.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Antisense correction of SMN2 splicing converted a precise RNA-mechanistic insight into a transformative treatment for spinal muscular atrophy.
assessment.attribution: Krainer and Bennett capture complementary central contributions in splicing biology and antisense therapeutic development.
assessment.maturity: Clinical benefit and the mechanistic basis are well established.
uncertainties: Important contributions also arose from broader preclinical and clinical development efforts.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: BCR-ABL inhibition provided a defining demonstration that molecularly targeted therapy can profoundly alter the course of a human cancer.
assessment.attribution: The proposed trio reflects drug discovery, clinical translation, and the wider validation of targeted treatment in CML.
assessment.maturity: Long-term clinical experience makes both the therapeutic effect and its mechanistic interpretation highly mature.
uncertainties: Credit must also recognize foundational discovery of BCR-ABL and contributions beyond the listed therapeutic-development group.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Chaperonin-assisted protein folding established a fundamental principle for how cells achieve productive protein folding.
assessment.attribution: Horwich and Hartl are the clear central figures in the mechanistic elucidation of chaperonin-mediated folding.
assessment.maturity: The discovery has been repeatedly confirmed and remains foundational to cell biology and disease understanding.
uncertainties: The broader protein-folding field includes several related molecular systems and contributors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The recognition of distinct T- and B-lymphocyte lineages created a central framework for adaptive immunology.
assessment.attribution: Miller and Cooper provide a compact and compelling attribution for the complementary lineage discoveries.
assessment.maturity: Decades of immunological and clinical research have fully consolidated the framework.
uncertainties: The historical development of lymphocyte-lineage concepts involved multiple experimental traditions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optogenetics supplied an unprecedented causal means to control defined cells and has reshaped experimental neuroscience and physiology.
assessment.attribution: The proposed group links discovery of suitable microbial photoreceptors with their decisive application to genetically specified neural circuits.
assessment.maturity: Its reproducibility, breadth of use, and influence on circuit-level causal analysis are well established.
uncertainties: The innovation has many indispensable contributors, making a three-person attribution intrinsically restrictive.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Massively parallel sequencing transformed the scale of human genetics, biology, and diagnostic research.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian, Klenerman, and Mayer represent central contributions to leading sequencing-by-synthesis approaches.
assessment.maturity: The technology has undergone extensive validation and has pervasive biomedical impact.
uncertainties: Parallel sequencing developed through several technically distinct platforms and a wider network of contributors.
